title: Hezbollah Drone Strikes IDF Bulldozer Near Beaufort Ridge
detail: Hezbollah struck an unmanned IDF bulldozer with an explosive drone near the Beaufort Ridge in south Lebanon. Israel characterized the attack as a "blatant" violation of the ceasefire agreement, and Defense Minister Katz and Prime Minister Netanyahu vowed a severe response, which materialized the following day with the demolition of Hezbollah's underground tunnel network beneath the ridge.

media.caption: An IDF soldier in a Hezbollah tunnel near Beaufort Castle, southern Lebanon
